analysis.title: Full-Stack Principal Engineer Portfolio & Case Study Platform

intentAnalysis.mainGoal: Build a credible, high-converting engineering portfolio website that demonstrates real architectural capability, interactive case studies, and direct contact workflow.
secondaryGoals: Showcase production code repositories, live deployments, and measurable engineering metrics
Provide recruiters and hiring managers with fast filtering by tech stack and domain
Enable direct message submission and resume download without broken links
intentAnalysis.actualIntendedOutcome: Win senior/staff engineering interviews or high-value technical consulting contracts through verifiable technical proof.
intentAnalysis.targetUsers: Engineering VPs, Technical Recruiters, CTOs, and Potential Consulting Clients
intentAnalysis.platform: Responsive Web Application (Desktop 1440px baseline + Mobile-first touch support)
intentAnalysis.expectedOutput: Complete, deployable React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS full-stack web application
requiredFunctionality: Interactive project filtering by technology, architecture, and year
Deep-dive technical case study modal/drawer with system architecture notes and trade-offs
Working contact inquiry form with server-side validation and persistent message storage
Searchable engineering writing / technical notes section
userExperienceExpectations: Editorial typography with zero visual clutter and fast keyboard navigation
Immediate scannability of core stack, years of experience, and impact metrics
WCAG AA contrast compliance and reduced-motion support
externalServicesRequired: Optional GitHub API or structured local project registry
intentAnalysis.backendRequirements: Node.js / Express API endpoint for contact submissions and dynamic project metrics
intentAnalysis.databaseRequirements: Persistent storage for contact inquiries and case study analytics
intentAnalysis.authenticationRequirements: Public read access; protected admin view if managing inquiries in-app
intentAnalysis.fileMediaRequirements: High-contrast system architecture diagrams and responsive project preview screenshots
intentAnalysis.apiRequirements: REST endpoints for /api/projects and /api/contact with strict input validation
intentAnalysis.deploymentRequirements: Production build bundling frontend assets with Node.js server on port 3000

extractedRequirements.rationale: Explicitly stated core objective in the user prompt.

extractedRequirements.statement: Include interactive project case studies with problem, architecture, and measurable outcome sections
extractedRequirements.rationale: Hiring managers evaluate senior developers on architectural trade-offs and measurable outcomes rather than screenshots alone.

extractedRequirements.statement: Implement a working contact form with server-side validation and submission persistence
extractedRequirements.rationale: Ensures the portfolio is a functional lead-capture application rather than a static mockup.

extractedRequirements.statement: Assume target persona is a Full-Stack Software Engineer showcasing 4-6 flagship projects
extractedRequirements.rationale: User did not specify specialization; a balanced full-stack structure is adaptable.

missingInformation: Specific engineering specialization (e.g., Frontend, Distributed Systems, AI/ML, Mobile)
Whether a CMS/admin dashboard is needed to edit projects dynamically
Preferred visual theme (Dark technical workspace vs. Light editorial broadsheet)

clarificationQuestions.question: What is the primary engineering specialization to highlight?
clarificationQuestions.whyImportant: Determines whether project cards emphasize UI fidelity, system throughput metrics, or model evaluation benchmarks.

clarificationQuestions.question: How should visitor contact inquiries be handled?
clarificationQuestions.whyImportant: Dictates backend route implementation and storage schema.
options: Full backend form with persistent inbox viewer
Backend form API with JSON storage
clarificationQuestions.sensibleDefault: Full backend form with persistent inbox viewer

clarificationQuestions.question: Which visual aesthetic best fits your personal brand?
clarificationQuestions.whyImportant: Shapes typography pairings, surface contrast, and layout rhythm.

assumptions: Assumed the developer wants a self-contained React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS application with an Express backend for contact submissions.
Assumed projects should support live filtering by technology tag and search query.
Assumed contact messages are persisted to the backend database and viewable in an inbox drawer.

recommendedTechnologies.name: React 19 + TypeScript
recommendedTechnologies.reason: Type-safe component architecture for interactive project filtering, modals, and state management.

recommendedTechnologies.name: Tailwind CSS v4
recommendedTechnologies.reason: Zero-runtime utility styling for responsive grid layouts, dark/light theme tokens, and accessible focus states.

recommendedTechnologies.name: Express
recommendedTechnologies.reason: Handles contact form validation, rate limiting, and persistent storage of inquiries.

qualityAudit.summary: Prompt preserves the core portfolio objective, separates explicit user requests from architectural assumptions, and enforces real working interactive features.
autoImprovementsApplied: Added explicit mandatory rule prohibiting non-functional placeholder buttons or dead links.
Added structured Acceptance Criteria covering mobile responsiveness, keyboard accessibility, and form validation.

checks.notes: Directly targets a professional developer portfolio.
Explicitly labeled USER REQUIREMENT vs AI RECOMMENDATION vs ASSUMPTION.
Includes strict mandate that every filter, modal, and form works end-to-end.

structureSections.heading: 1. ROLE & PROJECT OBJECTIVE
structureSections.content: Act as a Principal Full-Stack Engineer and Design Systems Architect. Build a complete, production-ready Developer Portfolio & Interactive Case Study Web Application. This must NOT be a UI-only prototype or static demo. Every interactive feature—including category filtering, live search, case-study deep-dive drawers, theme switching, resume export, and the backend contact submission workflow—must actually work.

analysis.finalPrompt:
### 1. ROLE
Act as a Principal Full-Stack Software Engineer and Design Systems Architect.

### 2. PROJECT OBJECTIVE
Build a complete, production-ready **Developer Portfolio & Technical Case Study Web Application**.
**CRITICAL REQUIREMENT:** This must NOT be a UI-only prototype or static demo. Every interactive feature must actually work end-to-end.
